raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`Glm47MoeDetector._process_xml_to_json_streaming` appends every emitted string, array, object, and boolean character to `_current_value`. Those values have already been streamed, and the closing-tag branch only uses the remaining tail. Attribute string concatenation repeatedly copies an increasingly large value that is never consumed.

## Modifications

Remove the two redundant accumulations for values emitted incrementally. Keep buffering for `auto`, `number`, and `integer`, which are parsed at the closing tag. Empty values, JSON escaping, partial closing tags, and reset behavior retain their existing paths.

This is separate from #42575: it removes argument-value copies inside the streaming state machine and does not change regex matching or argument-pair scanning.

## Accuracy Tests

**34 relevant GLM47/IQuest tests passed**, including three new regression methods. The new buffer-retention test fails on unmodified upstream for all four streamed value types and passes with this patch. Numeric and inferred values retain their complete buffers and outputs. An additional 2,000 seeded synthetic differential cases compare every per-chunk parser result with unmodified upstream, including randomly split markup and malformed fragments.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/function_call/test_glm47_schema_types.py \
  test/registered/unit/function_call/test_glm47_streaming_buffer.py \
  test/registered/unit/function_call/test_function_call_parser.py \
  -k 'Glm47 or IQuest'
```

The entire function-call directory was not completed: unrelated DeepSeek tests require uncached model configuration downloads. No full-suite pass is claimed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Synthetic CPU measurement on AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9945WX, CPython 3.12.15. One typed string argument containing repeated `a` characters, streamed in 32-character chunks. Six samples per version after one warmup, alternating version order; outputs checked identical. Baseline is upstream `e6072935bf`, compared with the same source plus this change.

| Scope | Argument characters | Before, median | After, median |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| XML-to-JSON streaming stage | 16,384 | 12.64 ms | 10.43 ms |
| XML-to-JSON streaming stage | 65,536 | 59.36 ms | 39.69 ms |
| XML-to-JSON streaming stage | 262,144 | 404.99 ms | 161.56 ms |
| Full `parse_streaming_increment` path | 65,536 | 885.25 ms | 865.72 ms |

The large stage-local reduction is not a whole-parser or model throughput claim. The full parser still rescans the accumulated tool-call buffer and improved by only about 2% in this workload. GPU inference was not benchmarked for this CPU-only change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add registered CPU regression tests.
- [x] Explain the retained buffering contract in code; no configuration changes.
- [x] Provide output-equivalence checks and scoped CPU measurements.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

Developed with AI assistance.

The one difference is booleans and non-JSON containers (`True`, `1, 2`): #43275 holds those until `</arg_value>` so they come out as valid JSON (`true`, `[1, 2]`), which your test's `_current_value == ""` assertion would flag. detail.title: [Function Call] Avoid copying already streamed GLM47 argument values

files.patch:
@@ -515,15 +515,15 @@ def _process_xml_to_json_streaming(
                                 json_output += json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False)[
                                     1:-1
                                 ]
-                                self._current_value += content
+                                # Already emitted values are not read at closing;
+                                # retaining them copies the growing value per char.
                                 self._xml_tag_buffer = ""
                         else:
                             # object/array/boolean values stream through verbatim
                             if content:
                                 if not self._value_started:
                                     self._value_started = True
                                 json_output += content
-                                self._current_value += content
                                 self._xml_tag_buffer = ""
 
         return json_output

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+import json
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Function, Tool
+from sglang.srt.function_call.glm47_moe_detector import Glm47MoeDetector
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def make_tools(field):
+    return [
+        Tool(
+            type="function",
+            function=Function(
+                name="inspect",
+                parameters={"type": "object", "properties": {"value": field}},
+            ),
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+class TestGlm47StreamingBuffer(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_emitted_values_are_not_retained_in_argument_buffer(self):
+        for value_type, value in (
+            ("string", 'line\n"quoted" \\ café <tag> ' * 256),
+            ("array", list(range(256))),
+            ("object", {str(i): i for i in range(128)}),
+            ("boolean", True),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(value_type=value_type):
+                tools = make_tools({"type": value_type})
+                raw = value if value_type == "string" else json.dumps(value)
+                detector = Glm47MoeDetector()
+                chunks = ["<tool_call>inspect<arg_key>value</arg_key><arg_value>"]
+                chunks.extend(raw[i : i + 31] for i in range(0, len(raw), 31))
+                calls = []
+                for chunk in chunks:
+                    calls.extend(detector.parse_streaming_increment(chunk, tools).calls)
+                    # The XML tail can retain a partial closing tag. Already
+                    # emitted argument content must not accumulate a second copy.
+                    self.assertEqual(detector._current_value, "")
+                for char in "</arg_value></tool_call>":
+                    calls.extend(detector.parse_streaming_increment(char, tools).calls)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    json.loads("".join(call.parameters for call in calls)),
+                    {"value": value},
+                )
+
+    def test_empty_values_and_closing_tag_boundaries(self):
+        for raw in ("", "a", "<tag>", "</arg_val suffix", 'x\n"y"\\z', "é"):
+            text = (
+                "<tool_call>inspect<arg_key>value</arg_key><arg_value>"
+                + raw
+                + "</arg_value></tool_call>"
+            )
+            for size in (1, 7, len(text)):
+                with self.subTest(raw=raw, chunk_size=size):
+                    detector = Glm47MoeDetector()
+                    calls = []
+                    for offset in range(0, len(text), size):
+                        calls.extend(
+                            detector.parse_streaming_increment(
+                                text[offset : offset + size],
+                                make_tools({"type": "string"}),
+                            ).calls
+                        )
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        json.loads("".join(call.parameters for call in calls)),
+                        {"value": raw},
+                    )
+
+    def test_buffered_numeric_and_inferred_values_are_preserved(self):
+        for field, raw, expected in (
+            ({"type": "integer"}, "123456", 123456),
+            ({"type": "number"}, "1.25e2", 125.0),
+            ({}, '{"ok": true}', {"ok": True}),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(field=field, raw=raw):
+                detector = Glm47MoeDetector()
+                tools = make_tools(field)
+                text = (
+                    "<tool_call>inspect<arg_key>value</arg_key><arg_value>"
+                    + raw
+                    + "</arg_value></tool_call>"
+                )
+                calls = []
+                for char in text:
+                    calls.extend(detector.parse_streaming_increment(char, tools).calls)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    json.loads("".join(call.parameters for call in calls)),
+                    {"value": expected},
+                )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
